model.head: sheckhy
model.argument_rule: Exact immediately next raw whole group on same P-line, consecutive numeric group index and definite space from both sides. No case/spelling/segmentation normalization.
model.producer_rule: Each licensed sheckhy+A pair creates a record keyed by exact A, with payload(head,A,original producer span). This is an anonymous authored constructor; no action, substance, agent, quantity or physical object is identified.
model.reference_rule: Each licensed lsheckhy+A requests the most recent earlier licensed sheckhy+A record on the SAME SOURCE PAGE. Its output must copy the selected stored payload and actual producer IDs. No initial records, aliases, hidden R producers, across-page context or future anchors.
model.order: Source-row-index numeric then source-group-index numeric. Prior producer ends before reference starts.
model.word_semantics: A is an opaque exact-form label under the construction, not a confirmed class, individual or English meaning. Only this exact sheckhy/lsheckhy correspondence is hypothesized; no general l-translation or prefix rule.
model.unknowns: All other groups retain raw content and source position; their semantic effects are unknown, not asserted no-ops. The test checks an explicit licensed written-anchor duty, not the actual impossibility of another producer in unread words.
model.scope_diagnostic: Same-paragraph status may be recorded using original reader flags but is not an alternate gate; primary scope is the whole source page. No cross-reader paragraph flag borrowing.
